scope: JWT session expiry and maximum token age enforcement.

unexpiredTokenWithIatOlderThanEightHours.reason: A future exp alone must not permit an authentication session older than the application eight-hour lifetime.

fix: JWT verification now enforces maxAge=8h and rejects payloads without a finite exp claim before loading the user.

includes: validly signed token without exp returns 401 INVALID_TOKEN before database lookup
unexpired token with iat older than eight hours returns 401 INVALID_TOKEN before database lookup
valid token with an eight-hour expiry is accepted and performs the user lookup
